snippet.title: Land of the Dead Trees - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for Land of the Dead Trees, an upcoming action roguelike extraction RPG developed by Red Core Interactive. Players will reside on the fine line between life and death to pick up the pieces of a world decaying by the minute. Make use of an array of weapons, attain permanent upgrades and abilities from run to run, and reach the safe zone. Land of the Dead Trees is coming soon to PC (Steam).
